title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・未踏の栄光

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Under the clear autumn sky, a great cheer resounds from the crowd in celebration of Mejiro McQueen's victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: An indescribable joy wells in her heart as she receives praise and congratulations from me, the spectators, and members of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's been through some difficult times—times when she even doubted herself. But she persisted and continued running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, she becomes the first of her family to conquer both the spring and autumn races of the Tenno Sho.
